charged to the autoclave; the text offers this ligand or the xanthene ligand as alternatives and prints one 4 g charge for whichever is used

procedure_text: 向高压釜中加入式(IV)化合物56.84g、1,3-环己二酮21.84g、三乙胺37.95g、PdCl₂催化剂0.5g、配体2-双环己基膦-2',6'-二甲氧基联苯或4,5-双二苯基膦-9,9-二甲基氧杂蒽4g、溶剂1,4-二氧六环290g，抽真空，氮气置换3次，通入1～4MPa的CO，在85℃反应约10h。收率低于10％，不理想。
procedure_summary: A palladium-catalysed carbonylative coupling of the formula (IV) aryl bromide with 1,3-cyclohexanedione under carbon monoxide pressure in dioxane with triethylamine and a phosphine ligand, run in an autoclave after nitrogen purging. The text reports only that the yield was low and the result unsatisfactory; no product is isolated and no workup is described.
notes: Section label disagreement, recorded not resolved: the patent prints 实施例11 (Example 11), but the step reports a yield below 10% described as 不理想 (unsatisfactory) and A0 typed the section comparative_example on that content. Both readings stand. No numeric yield is recorded: 低于10％ (below 10%) is a bound, not a printed yield figure, and no product mass, name or workup is given, so product_name is null and missing_product is raised. A0 estimated 1 step and this is 1 step; the whole section is a single charge with a single transformation and no workup between operations, so is_one_pot is false. The starting material 式(IV)化合物 is a bare formula label whose structure this section does not give; the same identifier is the section product of Example 5 and the substrate of Examples 6, 7, 9 and 10. It is the identical A1 identifier in every one of those sections, so the charge here is matched to Example 5 by compound identity and not by adjacency: precursor_step is Example 5::Step 1 and linkage_confirmed is true. cross_reference_unresolved is false because the reference is locatable in the patent. reaction_class is other_cross_coupling with medium confidence: the transformation is a Pd/phosphine carbonylative coupling of an aryl halide with a 1,3-diketone under CO, which is a cross-coupling with CO insertion and matches no more specific class in the list; acylation would describe the bond formed at the diketone but not the catalytic aryl-halide coupling that defines the step. The two phosphine ligands are printed as alternatives joined by 或 (or) with one 4 g charge, so both carry 4.0 g and it is not a sum. The 1-4 MPa CO charge is recorded as elevated pressure with the range in qualitative_text because no single value_kpa is printed. Time is 约10h (about 10 h), recorded as 10.0. A stirrer is not mentioned, so stirring.type is left null. This section contains no IMAGE_EXTRACT span, so there is no drawing to corroborate or contradict the prose. reaction_class is the same value used for the palladium-catalysed carbonylations of this same aryl bromide in Examples 6, 7 and 9, so that one transformation does not appear under two classes across the worked examples.
